title: Hearing on child care worker background check delays
summary: The Council will hold an oversight hearing examining delays in processing required background checks for child care providers, employees and volunteers, and their effects such as staffing shortages and program closures. The Health Committee, Oversight and Investigations Committee and Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education will also consider bills that would limit repeat background checks within five years, require posting and notice of child care center closure orders, and provide unpaid leave for bone marrow and organ donation. Witnesses invited include the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, the Mayor's Office of Child Care and advocacy groups.
